contract: The replacement runs as a standalone executable without a Node runtime. Startup on a disposable existing installation serves the pinned boot contract and preserves the stored identity; a corrupt config, a config path that is a file, or an unwritable metadata tree is refused without persisting the override.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.

With an unwritable metadata tree upstream logs repeated unhandled rejections and does not exit promptly; the scenario pins only the client-visible effect (never ready, nothing created) and the harness kills the process after SIGINT.

invariants.contract: A standalone boot of a fresh install serves /ping {success:true}, /status with isInit false and app audiobookshelf/version 2.37.2, the bundled client entry document and the auth-gated API 401 from one process; reopening an existing install serves the same library ids, user count and initialised status after a new process starts on the same tree.

A corrupt absdatabase.sqlite or a CONFIG_PATH that is a regular file exits non-zero, answers no HTTP and leaves the supplied bytes and the install config directory unchanged; an unwritable METADATA_PATH never becomes HTTP-ready and creates no files in that tree.
